channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] First on Scripps: New analysis finds prices for school supplies, lunch staples have surged since 2025
item.description: Parents gearing up for the back-to-school season may soon face sticker shock as prices for classroom supplies and lunchbox staples have increased significantly since last year.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Macron holds crisis meeting as monster wildfires drive 250,000 from their homes
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron held a crisis meeting Monday to address uncontrolled wildfires that have forced over 250,000 people to flee their homes.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 'It stopped working': Why customer reviews matter when buying major appliances
item.description: Many of us buy appliances based on looks, features, and whether it is on sale. But one mother and her teen daughter regret not researching their wall oven.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: evacuation] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] News to Know for July 27, 2026
item.description: Families say they weren't notified during Aviata evacuation. Plus, woman charged after 3-year-old dies in her care to face judge today.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Woman in court facing murder charge after 3-year-old dies in her care
item.description: Grace Wingate is scheduled to be in court Monday morning for an arraignment hearing. She faces murder charges, accused of killing a 3-year-old child.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Pasco family sues sheriff’s officer after fleeing driver slams into man on lawnmower leaving him brain damaged
item.description: A Florida family is taking the Pasco Sheriff's Office to court after a high-speed pursuit in New Port Richey ended with a fleeing driver hitting a landscaper on July 8, 2021.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Emu on the loose leads Dade City officers on chase
item.description: A rogue emu sparked an unusual police chase after wandering through town before officers successfully brought the bird under control.
